description.value: Hello Nori is a Japanese hand roll bar specializing in Temaki-style sushi, built around the philosophy of crispy premium nori, warm seasoned rice, and sustainable Ocean Wise seafood sourced locally and from select imports. Each hand roll is individually prepared to order at an open chef's bar, creating a quick yet considered dining experience. The brand has several BC locations and draws both local regulars and travelling guests.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Hello Nori is an active multi-location Japanese hand roll chain with several BC locations (Robson/Vancouver, Brentwood/Burnaby, Richmond, Park Royal/West Vancouver, Club Kitchen/Vancouver), but no location is listed in North Vancouver as the OSM community tag states; the OSM coordinates (~49.326, -123.137) most closely align with the Park Royal location in West Vancouver. The FAQ confirms takeout and delivery are available, and the menu page explicitly labels items as 'Gluten-Free - Vegan - Oceanwise' with vegan hand roll options listed. No bike parking, bike rack, water refill, or washroom information appears anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM community tag says 'North Vancouver' but no Hello Nori location is listed in North Vancouver on the website; based on coordinates (~49.326, -123.137), the most plausible match is the Park Royal location at 731 Main St #140, West Vancouver, BC V7T 0A5.
